description: This file provides implementation support for interacting with the CometAPI's chat completion endpoint, including configuration, request transformation, URL handling, streaming response parsing, and error handling. It extends OpenAI-compatible API classes to accommodate CometAPI-specific features.

classes.name: CometAPIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for CometAPI, inheriting from OpenAIGPTConfig, with methods for parameter mapping, request transformation, URL generation, and error handling tailored for CometAPI.

classes.name: CometAPIChatCompletionStreamingHandler
classes.description: Handles streaming chat completion responses from CometAPI, parsing chunks, handling errors, and extracting choices.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters to CometAPI-specific parameters, allowing for customization.

methods.name: Tuple[List[AllMessageValues],Optional[List["ChatCompletionToolParam"]]] remove_cache_control_flag_from_messages_and_tools( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], tools: Optional[List["ChatCompletionToolParam"]] = None, )
methods.description: Removes cache control flags from messages and tools, using default behavior for CometAPI.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms and compiles the request data payload sent to the API, incorporating additional body parameters.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Generates the complete API URL for CometAPI, adding /v1/ if necessary.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns the CometAPI-specific error class used for error responses.

methods.name: Any get_model_response_iterator( self, streaming_response: Union[Iterator[str], AsyncIterator[str], ModelResponse], sync_stream: bool, json_mode: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Creates an iterator for streaming responses from CometAPI.
